QUOTE: Two opt-in test-only settings exist: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` ... They mark secret inputs as undefined and let the test run under valgrind memcheck or clang MSan ... These are explicitly not part of the public API.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says constant-flow is verified by opt-in test-only facilities built on valgrind and MemorySanitizer, and states they are explicitly not part of the public API.
